metaTitle: Your digital bridge to your customers

hero.badge: First 100 appointments free — no card required
hero.subtitle: Uponco is appointment booking software for your business — every location, every service, online or onsite. Set up in five minutes and let customers book in seconds.

value.heading: Bookings, without the back-and-forth
value.subheading: Share one link. Uponco takes care of the rest.

bookingPage.title: Your own booking page
bookingPage.description: Customers pick a service, a specialist and a free time slot — no calls, no messages, no account needed.

sharedCalendar.title: One calendar for the team
sharedCalendar.description: Every location, service and team member in one place, with double bookings blocked automatically.

reminders.title: Automatic reminders
reminders.description: Uponco emails every customer before their appointment, so far fewer of them forget to show up.

setup.heading: Live in five minutes
setup.subheading: No setup fee, no installation, no training day.

setUp.title: Set up your business
setUp.description: Add your locations, services, team and working hours.

share.title: Share your link
share.description: Send your booking link out, or embed it on your own website.

run.title: Start taking bookings
run.description: Everything lands in one calendar your whole team can see.

dataStrip.heading: Your data stays yours
dataStrip.description: Uponco only asks for what it needs to run your bookings. We never sell your data or your customers' data.

footer.tagline: Uponco is your digital bridge to your customers — easy appointment booking for every location and service, online or onsite.
